Many folks ask me how to start a business, here are the steps, in general.

**1. Choosing a Type/Structure:**

The US Small Business Administration (SBA) has a ton of information about starting, structuring, and launching a business. The SBA.Gov website has a special topic on choosing a [Business Structure](https://www.sba.gov/business-guide/launch/choose-business-structure-types-chart).

**Most Common:**

  -------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------- -------------------------------
  **Business structure**                             **Ownership**                                                             **Liability**                      **Taxes**

  Business structure:                                Ownership:                                                                Liability:                         Taxes:

  **Sole proprietorship (often uses a DBA / ABN)**   One person                                                                Unlimited personal liability       Personal tax only

  Business structure:                                Ownership:                                                                Liability:                         Taxes:

  **Limited liability company (LLC)**                One or more people                                                        Owners are not personally liable   Self-employment tax

                                                                                                                                                                  Personal tax or corporate tax

  Business structure:                                Ownership:                                                                Liability:                         Taxes:

  **Corporation - C corp**                           One or more people                                                        Owners are not personally liable   Corporate tax

  Business structure:                                Ownership:                                                                Liability:                         Taxes:

  **Corporation - S corp**                           One or more people, but no more than 100, and all must be U.S. citizens   Owners are not personally liable   Personal tax
  -------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------- -------------------------------

**2.** Entity** Filing in Idaho**

The Idaho Secretary of State [website](https://sos.idaho.gov/) contains all of the forms one could need to star their business filing. On the left, select [Business Entities](https://sos.idaho.gov/corp/index.html), the select the entity type you are interested in creating.

Most common are:

> - A[ssumed Business Name (ABN)](https://sos.idaho.gov/corp/abn_form.html) / Doing Business As (DBA)
> - [Corporation](https://sos.idaho.gov/corp/corp_form.html) (INC)
> - [Limited Liability Company](https://sos.idaho.gov/corp/llc_form.html) (LLC)

You will print out the form, sign it, and send it by mail with a check for the filing fee (\$25 or \$100, typically). The Secretary of State in Idaho takes FOREVER to complete the filing. Could be two weeks, could be six weeks. Could be longer.

 **3. EIN / Tax ID**

If you are any type of business except a Sole Proprietor using your name or an ABN/DBA, you'll need to have a Tax ID (EIN). Simple, easy, and Free process. Just go to [IRS.Gov](https://www.irs.gov/), select "[Apply for an Employer ID Number (EIN)](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/apply-for-an-employer-identification-number-ein-online)", under step 3 select [Apply Now](https://sa.www4.irs.gov/modiein/individual/index.jsp), then select Begin Application. Follow the prompts and make sure to save the PDF at the end before closing the screen.

 **4. Opening Your Business Accounts**

Once the Secretary of State shows the filing on their website, we're ready to open accounts. We can pull that paperwork directly from the site, so you just bring your ID, opening deposit, and EIN/TaxID.
